instruction: Candid photographic medium shot in a boxing gym. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1) holds a black punching bag steady, watching the training. On the right, the blonde woman in the purple cropped hoodie (R2) fully extends a right punch with her brown glove against the bag. A mirror on the far right reflects the gym interior. Soft overhead lighting illuminates the action.
